bug_semantics: CWE-78 command injection in @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm when the CLI is invoked with --workspace <value> and npm_execpath is unset or empty. BomBuilder copies the user-supplied workspace string into npm ls argv as `--workspace=${workspace}` with no shell escaping. makeNpmRunner's fallback then concatenates that argv into a single command string and runs it via child_process.execSync, so shell metacharacters in the workspace value are interpreted by a subshell as OS commands of the invoking user. The npm_execpath-present path uses execFileSync and is not this bug.
flaw_origin: The execSync('npm ' + args.join(' ')) fallback already existed (src/npmRunner.ts, first written in 719b99a0fd542d1d54f1b07609874ee864f2b605) under an explicit assumption that callers fully controlled args. The first-write of this CVE is 7da79c148dae1f6105e1a65048989626377019cf (PR #1212), which added free-form CLI --workspace and interpolated it into those unsanitized args. That is the smallest commit where the --workspace injection path exists; a later indent-only refactor (d6da4cee8d86bf4f6c5688e5f1677ae2597cfe20) is not the BIC.

That commit is therefore the BIC: it is the first public-history object on main where the complete --workspace injection exists.
